newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani rupee ends steady in kerb, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani rupee ends steady in kerb, seen stable.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee closed steady in the kerb market at 40.95 to the dollar in dull trading on Thursday after a government official dampened dollar demand saying the rupee would not be devalued again, dealers said.
They said the rate was likely to open stable on Saturday after Friday's weekend market closure.
The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on September 10, was 36.9700/37.1549 rupees to the dollar.
The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed unchanged at 10.50 percent. -- Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
